item.text: The project is nested under `benchmark-repo/`; I found the target files there and am reading the component behavior and existing test style now.

The bug is local: `submitLogin` throws for an empty password and can also throw if the password field is missing. I’m changing that branch to return the expected validation object and adding a regression that confirms `authenticate` is not called.
The patch is in place. I’m running the frontend test suite from `benchmark-repo` to verify both the regression and the existing valid-login behavior.

Implemented the empty-password fix in [LoginForm.jsx](/home/dylan/EmpathyEthics/Heart AI Foundation/cgp-benchmark/worktrees/task-6-codex-baseline-r1/benchmark-repo/frontend/src/components/LoginForm.jsx) and added a regression test in [components.test.js](/home/dylan/EmpathyEthics/Heart AI Foundation/cgp-benchmark/worktrees/task-6-codex-baseline-r1/benchmark-repo/frontend/tests/components.test.js).

Empty passwords now return `{ ok: false, error: "Password is required" }` without calling `authenticate`, while valid credentials still delegate normally.
